title: Ladoo Heist
hook: Tiptoe past a sleeping bear and sneak every ladoo out of Grandma's kitchen.

theme.keyArtPrompt: A huge sleeping brown bear snoring in a cozy Indian grandma's kitchen, plates of golden ladoos on every counter, warm lamplight

sprites.player: tiny sneaky kid in socks, top-down cartoon
sprites.ladoo: golden round ladoo sweet, top-down cartoon
sprites.bear: sleeping brown bear in an apron, top-down cartoon

timeline.hostLine: The bear is sleepwalking! Hide behind the fridge!
Final stretch: every ladoo counts double!

host.intro: Grandma's ladoos are out and the bear is snoring. Steal them all.
host.finale: The bear wakes up to an empty kitchen. Who is the ladoo legend?
host.tutorial: Move with the stick, hold Tiptoe to stay quiet, tap Grab to snatch a ladoo.
